approval.note: Owner decision R05-Q04 (17 Oct 2026). Not a clinical guideline: the hospital Tumour Board reviews this minimum set before real use.

note: Not a clinical guideline. Used for a cancer that has no built checklist yet (a cancer typed by the doctor, or a listed cancer whose checklist is not built): the Case File requires four core records only, histopathology, staging imaging, a clinical note with performance status, and the question for the board, labelled 'No disease-specific Indian protocol'. The four records rest on the owner decision R05-Q04 (17 Oct 2026), not on a guideline, and say nothing about which investigations this cancer needs: the treating team decides that. The cancer's name is kept on the Case File as the doctor wrote it (case.json cancer_name). Must be reviewed by the hospital Tumour Board before real use (clinical review); a disease-specific checklist replaces it as soon as one is built.
settings_note: One setting only: the records are the same whatever the extent of disease. The system never computes a stage.
